errors.network: Can't reach the app. Check that Docker is running.
errors.validation: Check the fields: something is filled in wrong.
errors.internal: Error inside the app. Details are in the log.
errors.no_key: Google is not connected. Upload a key on the “Google connection” screen.
errors.key_invalid: This does not look like a Google service account key.
errors.billing_disabled: Billing is not enabled in the Google project.
errors.api_disabled: The Vertex AI API is not enabled in the Google project.
errors.permission_denied: The service account lacks the needed permissions in the Google project.
errors.model_not_found: Google did not find this model in your project or region.
errors.rate_limited: Google asks to slow down: too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_grant: The key was revoked or deleted in Google. Upload a new one.
errors.safety_blocked: Google declined this under its safety rules. Refusals are not billed.
errors.refused: The model answered without a result. Try rephrasing.
errors.timeout: Google did not answer in time.
errors.server_error: Google has a temporary error. Try again.
errors.daily_cap: The daily spending limit from settings is reached.
errors.model_disabled: This model is turned off in settings.
errors.no_model: No enabled model for this action.
errors.file_in_use: The file is in use and cannot be deleted.
errors.invalid_setting: This value does not fit. Check the allowed range.
errors.unknown_setting: There is no such setting. Reload the page.
errors.model_unknown: This model is not in the list. Reload the page.
errors.model_is_default: The default model cannot be turned off. Make another model the default first.
errors.role_unknown: There is no such task for a text model. Reload the page.
errors.role_model_unsuitable: This model cannot do what this task needs.
errors.bad_price: The price is wrong: use numbers of 0 or more, and only the fields this model has.
errors.interrupted: The app stopped while this job was running.
errors.stuck: The job showed no progress for too long and was stopped.
errors.job_not_retryable: This job cannot be run again right now.
errors.unknown_job_kind: This app version does not know this job type.
errors.render_unavailable: The video assembly service is not responding. Check that all app containers are running.
errors.stt_unavailable: The speech-to-text service is not responding. Check that all app containers are running.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too big. The limit for this type is {max_mb} MB.
errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported here.
errors.upload_empty: The file is empty or was not sent.
errors.render_failed: Video processing failed. Details are in the log.
errors.bad_request: The request is wrong. Reload the page and try again.
